scope: Earth-like local landscapes, landforms, surfaces and vegetation; animals, humans, weather and sky excluded
performance_target: At least 100 fps at 1920x1080 on owner RTX 4060 / Ryzen 5700X, Medium vegetation, including dense forest. This is a target, not an achieved universal claim.
rollback_policy: Independent feature commits pushed regularly; no extra full player copies. Keep source art provenance and immutable asset inputs.

sources.use: Textured quads and instanced meshes are established vegetation representations; preserve ecological placement while changing rendering.
River patterns depend on discharge, sediment, slope and banks. Avoid the same sinusoid for every river.
Lowland bends, outer-bank erosion and inner-bank deposition.
Reuse plate motion and age-progressive hotspot chains rather than randomly placing volcanoes.
Isolated bedrock remnants and differential erosion; Uluru sandstone and Kata Tjuta conglomerate are distinct geological forms.
Incised uplifted sedimentary plateaus, strata with different resistance and tributary drainage.
Waterfalls belong to actual drainage and topographic breaks; separate falling-water geometry from sloping surface ribbons.
Bedrock resistance and river incision support knickpoints and falls.
Beach sediments reflect source geology, mineral transport and biogenic fragments; avoid uniform white shorelines.
Forest structure and understory distinguish regional vegetation, not merely green tint.
Coastal relief, resistant bedrock and sediment supply distinguish cliffs/headlands from protected pocket beaches. Rocky coasts are not restricted to one lithology.
Depositional shelves host beaches, bars, spits and dunes, with broad variation in width and composition.
Bars and barrier chains belong to relatively flat, sediment-supplied coasts. The current local pass provides intermittent nearshore bars, not a complete longshore sediment transport model.
Limestone dissolution produces dolines, cones and, in humid settings, steep towers and gorges. Distinguish carbonate relief from generic hills.
Exposed weak sediments undergo differential erosion and gullying; existing aridity, vegetation and mudstone controls admit dissected badland terrain.
Isolated resistant bedrock remnants differ from ordinary mountain noise. Admit rare coherent outcrops in appropriate dry, low-relief geology; do not populate every landscape with landmarks.
Foreshore, backshore berm and intermittent nearshore bars need different profiles; an ordinary lowland shore must not be classified as a cliff by its inherited hill amplitude.
Bare dissected weak sediments coexist with mixed-grass prairie. Review strong erosional formations as well as milder vegetated margins.
Tropical woody climbers root in the ground, ascend supporting trees and can have dangling branches. Shared-model climbers add no individual plant simulation.

Indexed indirect procedural draws can share the repeated card corners while retaining shader vertex IDs and exact triangles. Requires indexed argument layout; verify actual images, not only shader compilation.

coverage_review.existing_problem: Expensive blade geometry; uniform grass presentation
coverage_review.approach: Selectable textured clumps, physical height and cover retained; legacy blades remain selectable; actual paired screenshot and frame-time checks

coverage_review.existing_problem: Dense-rainforest baseline 117.5 fps versus 162.5 with vegetation shadows disabled
coverage_review.approach: Measure receiver filtering and caster costs separately, retain solid-object and character shadows

coverage_review.existing_problem: Fractal drainage edges lack convincing small-scale planform; cascades are only heightfield ramps
coverage_review.approach: Bounded bank/slope-dependent bends with coupled bed and surface; then real falls and varied reaches, tested at confluences and ocean mouths

coverage_review.existing_problem: Broad hotspot uplifts and plate chains exist; local craters and edifices do not
coverage_review.approach: Derive cratered shields/cones and erosion from existing mapped geological features and age

coverage_review.existing_problem: Local coast mostly follows interpolated elevation
coverage_review.approach: Source geology and exposure distinguish beaches, bars, rocky shores and cliffs; retain physical water datum

coverage_review.existing_problem: Badlands and karst controls produce only weak metre-scale noise
coverage_review.approach: Larger coherent erosional forms, stratified canyon/plateau and bedrock-remnant terrain with appropriate admission

coverage_review.existing_problem: Rainforest has some canopy anatomy and palms but lacks adequate local structural and surface variety
coverage_review.approach: Review actual crowns, ground light/cover, understory and materials; improve shared art instead of adding per-tree scripting

limits: These are game approximations, not hydrodynamics or geological simulation.
The Forest's proprietary implementation has not been inspected. The new grass follows a comparable textured-clump approach, not a claim of identical engine internals.
Initial three settled static benchmarks do not prove the all-world target. Travel, turning, additional dense regions and frame-time tails remain required.
PresentMon produced no presentation CSV in the hidden offscreen baseline. Its absence is not GPU timing evidence; app frame windows use explicit GPU drains.
